response.evidence: The Quick start section lists "npm pnpm Yarn" tabs, each followed by a command with the same comment: "# Initialize the Astro Component template in a new directory" (npm create astro@latest my-new-component-directory -- --template component; pnpm create astro@latest ...; yarn create astro my-new-component-directory --template component).
response.rationale: The three commands do the same thing, creating the component template in a new directory, and differ only in package manager. They are presented as package-manager tabs. Running all three would repeat the same action, so they are alternatives. The Quick start section does not say this outright, but elsewhere the artifact says to use "the package manager of your choice", which supports the same reading.
